name: Ammonite Man
notes: First spiritual entity of the Invertebrate Dominion. GM analogue for deep-time memory. Colossal sentient nautiloid of the deep Tethys. Primordial, with the Narmada Man and Owlman. Filed as mythology until he was noticed doing things only a person does -- negotiating with early humans, standing at four events across four eras. In the University’s draft reconstruction, he warned of anomalies, supported ecological recovery, and mediated between avian and Vanaran communities.
